thread:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to finalize SLOs for GPU allocation and pool saturation before exec review tomorrow.

elaine: Proposal:
- Allocation SLI: 5m success rate of GPU allocation RPCs.
- Allocation SLO: 99.5% over 30d.
- Saturation SLI: pool usable capacity > 15% of total (i.e., not saturated) measured as fraction of minutes in window.
- Saturation SLO: 99% of minutes in 30d window.

josh: SGTM. PromQL for allocation SLI:
```
sum(rate(gpu_alloc_success_total[5m])) / sum(rate(gpu_alloc_attempt_total[5m]))
```
Keep evaluation every 1m.

maria: For saturation, I suggest using node-level view to avoid double-counting on multi-gpu nodes:
```
avg_over_time((sum(node_gpu_free) / sum(node_gpu_total))[30d:1m])
```
This yields a fraction over time.

sam: For alerts, prefer burn-rate on errorbudget + steady degradation alert. Example thresholds:
- burn rate 7d > 3 => pager
- burn rate 1d > 6 => pager
- error budget remaining < 20% => ops channel

liam: Also add a low-cost mitigation: auto-burst to ephemeral spot pools in us-east1/us-west2 when allocation success < 98% for 10m. Add cost tag and manual approval for > $4k/day.

elaine: @josh @maria can you add these panels to the SLO dashboard? Name them 'GPU allocation SLI' and 'Pool usable capacity'. Keep 30d and 7d rolling windows.

josh: Will do. I'll add a tail-latency panel for allocation p99 too. PromQL for p99 tail-latency:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(gpu_alloc_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

infra-bot: Alert: gpu-pool-us-west2-saturation exceeded 85% for 6m at 1779123600

maria: Noted. I’ll check node-level logs for pod preemptions and kube-scheduler backs.

sam: FYI, cost impact estimate if we auto-burst to spot: +$4k/week if sustained. We should include finance sign-off for trial.

elaine: OK. I'll push this as PR to eng-sre/slo-defs and tag @finance. If no objections by EOD, we ship.

josh: No objections from me. :thumbsup:

liam: +1

maria: +1

elaine: Thanks everyone.
